title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The correct locations of the zeros in the magnetic field must be provided as x = ±1/sqrt(3) d.

title: Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the force on the middle wire must be correctly derived as f ≈ -μ0 I^2/π d^2 x.

title: Period of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The period of oscillation T must be correctly stated as T = 2π sqrt(m/μ0) d/I.

title: Qualitative Description
description: Important Criteria: A qualitative description of the motion of the middle wire after displacement must be provided, indicating simple harmonic motion.

title: Magnetic Field Sketch
description: Important Criteria: A sketch of the magnetic field lines must be included, showing the correct pattern around the wires.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the force expression or misinterpretation of the direction of forces.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations and final answers.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Discussing limiting cases or assumptions made during the derivation can enhance the response.
